## Upstream changes 6.73.0 -> 6.74.0

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — no breaking changes in the notes for this range, only deprecation warnings, new resources, and bug fixes. No companion service version is named by the notes, so that disqualifier does not apply.

Note: the image differences could not be checked (registry returned "HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized"), so this verdict rests on the release notes alone, not on a comparison of the actual image configurations.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes for 6.74.0. (The BREAKING CHANGES block present in this changelog excerpt belongs to 6.73.0 — the baseline already running — not to this upgrade.)

### Variables
- none. This is a Terraform provider, not a container with runtime env vars; the .env.example file provided is empty, and the compose/`.tf` file does not expose provider behavior through environment variables. The provider version constraint itself lives in `01-providers.tf`: `version = "~> 6.73.0"` — this pin must be bumped (e.g. to `~> 6.74.0`) for the upgrade to take effect, otherwise `terraform init -upgrade` will refuse to move past 6.73.x.

### Data and dependencies
- none introduced by this range. The notes contain several forward-looking deprecation warnings that are not breaking yet but should be tracked for a future major bump:
  - `data-source/aws_location_geofence_collection: Warn when kms_key_id is configured. The value has no effect, and a future version of the provider will reject it.`
  - `provider: Warn when tags_all is set in Plugin SDK V2 resource configurations. A future version of the provider will reject it.`
  - `provider: Warn when tags is set in data source configurations that don't filter by tags. ... A future version of the provider will reject it.`
  - `resource/aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream: Warn when arn is configured. ... a future version of the provider will reject it.`
  - `resource/aws_kinesis_stream: Warn when arn is configured. ... a future version of the provider will reject it.`
  - `resource/aws_rds_cluster: Warn when cluster_members is configured. ... a future version of the provider will reject it.`
  - `resource/aws_s3_object: object_lock_retain_until_date is now Computed because Amazon S3 assigns and advances the value for objects under an event hold. Removing the argument from configuration no longer plans a change.` — this is a plan-behavior change for anyone setting that argument on `aws_s3_object`, worth a one-time `terraform plan` check after upgrading, but it does not break applies.
- Already true at the current (6.73.0) baseline, not introduced by this upgrade: `resource/aws_efs_file_system: Until AWS roll out the service change supporting the new default encryption setting, changing encrypted = true to encrypted = false will seem to have succeeded without modifying anything on the AWS side.` This does not affect the verdict for 6.73.0 -> 6.74.0.

### Before applying
- Bump the version pin in `01-providers.tf` from `~> 6.73.0` to `~> 6.74.0` (or a range that admits it).
- Run `terraform init -upgrade` to pull the new provider build.
- Run `terraform plan` before apply, specifically checking any `aws_s3_object` resources that set `object_lock_retain_until_date` — this argument became `Computed` and may show as a no-op diff where it previously would have attempted a change.
- No state backup or manual migration command is called for by the notes; this is a provider version bump, not a resource schema migration with required state surgery.

### Notes read
- hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws release notes for v6.74.0 (target) and v6.73.0 (baseline, provided as "THE RELEASE THE TEMPLATE RUNS NOW"), plus the top portion of CHANGELOG.md covering 6.74.0 down through 6.71.0.
